reviews.text: Warm welcome, veterinarian with a big heart.
The welcome is always warm, you feel valued and you feel that your companions are in good hands
Excellent service and clean clinic.

What a welcome!

Thank you to Joanie, Annie, Marie-Eve, and Doc Dominic 🩵
Pure love for animals
Nath and Tibb

The staff were very professional and competent, and the service was very welcoming! I am very happy and satisfied with all the care the staff gave my beautiful little poodle, Enji. 🥰 Thank you so much to the whole team.
Excellent clinic, warm welcome
The entire team is attentive, passionate, and dedicated. I highly recommend them; you'll fall in love with them!
Diego enjoyed his visit despite his nervousness. Friendly staff
A huge thank you to the whole team at the clinic for taking such good care of my beautiful Shadow! ❤️🐾 I really appreciated your gentleness, your kindness and all the attention you gave him.
Thank you for taking care of Chiquita. Everyone was kind and helpful.
They were able to see me the same day for my cat's eye infection. Reasonable price. Courteous staff. Clean space. 😊
Excellent service
Attentive, professional, and dedicated. You're in good hands, and you can feel it. I highly recommend them!

I think it was very expensive. On the day of our cat's consultation, I was on the phone with my boyfriend to get the information, but unfortunately, I could barely hear the vet that day, as if he wasn't speaking loudly enough, and I didn't understand most of it. I feel like despite several negative results (which is good news), we've been left with an additional problem (possibly gas in his stomach), but no solution. I have no idea what I can do to help my cat, or even if I can help him at all. All we were told was that an ultrasound might reveal more; we'll see if we get an appointment soon.

A few days later, I spoke with Marie-Ève ​​about my receipt not arriving in my email, and she took the time to explain some things I hadn't understood. I thank her immensely for the time she took to explain what I was asking and for resolving the receipt issue; she also took the time to help me find some solutions for my furball.
Impeccable service with attentive staff
The vet was extremely knowledgeable and the welcome was very friendly!

I was lucky enough to find this clinic after a friend recommended it. The staff is welcoming and really helps you understand your pet's problem. The vet I saw was very gentle and explained everything clearly. The clinic is clean, bright, and inviting, and I've noticed my cat seems less stressed than when we went to our old clinic. They're our pets' new guardian angels, and we think we made a particularly good choice 💓

I took my cat to this clinic for a minor, unforeseen emergency and left a very satisfied customer.

Thank you to the entire team. The reception and follow-up care for my cat were excellent.
Exceptional service

Up in the sky, our Aya says thank you. Thank you for taking the time, thank you for helping her pass away peacefully. Thank you for your patience, your listening ear, and your kindness. Thank you for staying with Aya at the end of the day, even though time had passed.

Thank you.
Simply.

That word says it all.

Laurie and Simon.
Excellent service! I loved the way the animals were treated, the facilities, and the overall service from the staff.
Very detailed, caring independent vet office, we've been with the NDG office for years and we are glad they opened this location
I greatly appreciated the services of the staff and veterinarian at the East Veterinary Care Clinic. Thank you and see you soon!

I called before saying I'd be late 15mins cause my dog was sick.

They said it's fine, I drive there.

Once I arrived réceptionnist said that I'm too late (apt at 9AM, arrived at 9:20) that I should come back later.

After a 10mins argumentation about the fact that the receptionist told me it was fine and that I won't leave, they finally take me, veterinary leave me and my dog alone for over 45mins.

They don't want to give me the travel documentation the same day saying they don't have enough time to prepare it, also they mentioned I must do all the research by myself, they are the one preparing the documentation, not me? I pay for a service, I expected much better.

I'm sure there is better clinics around Montreal with who I wouldn't have struggled like this.
Excellent service 👍 …

Excellent service.
A team of courteous, caring, and professional people.
The treatments and options were very well explained by the veterinarians we consulted.
They were very patient and empathetic with my daughter during our cat's final days.
Their presence made all the difference.
The team is very welcoming and attentive to our needs. I feel confident.
Highly recommended – an independent company, not an American multinational. Efficient, understanding, and courteous staff. Reasonable prices. I've finally found the right veterinary clinic.
Thank you to the team for taking care of Apollo. The employees are courteous and the wait time isn't too long.
The visit was great, they did what they were supposed to without charging me extra, and my cat is doing much better.
Very satisfied with my visit. I will return.
I really liked the vet and the technicians were wonderful. This is now my go-to veterinary clinic for my pet.

I fell in love with this clinic. It's the third one I've tried in the area, and it's the one I'll stick with because I felt the staff were genuine and honest. They patiently explained my options to me, and I really enjoy supporting independent businesses.
The veterinarians and reception staff were very warm and friendly. My dog ​​received excellent treatment and care here. Highly recommended.

The welcome and care were exemplary. The staff were very respectful of our choices and made us feel no guilt if we didn't choose all the treatments offered. A huge thank you to the whole team, who even remembered my cat's name! 🥰
Friendly service, good communication, efficient handling of my pet's problem, and follow-up on the interventions the next day. The team was very responsive and available to answer our questions.
Quick appointment, very friendly staff!
Although it was a bit more expensive than elsewhere, the people there were welcoming and kind. It was a lovely experience. ☺️

My dog ​​was injured and his usual vet clinic was closed. The team at East Veterinary Care responded to his needs by agreeing to see us at the last minute, and he received excellent care. I highly recommend them for the quality of care, impeccable customer service, and transparent and reasonable prices!
EXCELLENT! And people from Quebec, for Quebec. Very good service; Dr. Jennifer Allan is very professional, as are all the staff I met. I love it!
A fantastic team! Friendly and professional service from start to finish! I've found my vet clinic and I'm so happy! Thank you!!!

A wonderful and peaceful experience, exceeding my expectations ☺️ My Milo's eye suddenly swelled, which worried me. He's timid, and even more so in a cage. Annie and Dr. Ciarlillo were incredibly patient and attentive to Milo's needs. That says it all for me regarding the quality of a vet appointment! I highly recommend them. Thank you again 🐾😽
I am very satisfied with my experience today. The vet and staff were very kind and took the time to answer all my questions. Thank you again!

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!

The entire team is remarkably kind and professional.

Every visit is a pleasure thanks to their warm welcome, their smiles, and their genuine desire to provide excellent service.

You can immediately tell how much they care about the well-being of the animals. Thank you for the excellent care and advice.

An exceptional team that I wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone looking for reliable veterinary care.

What's most impressive is that our dogs love coming to the clinic, which is quite rare for a vet visit! Even my anxious dog feels comfortable there.

As for prices, we've always found them reasonable and fair. You can tell that here, the priority is the well-being of the animals, not charging unnecessary fees.

The team takes the time to offer different treatment options while respecting our budget, so we can provide the best possible care for our animals without putting ourselves in a difficult financial situation.

We also greatly appreciated their excellent follow-up and their commitment to building long-term, trusting relationships with their clients. They seek accessible and realistic solutions rather than systematically recommending the most expensive options.

- Evelyne, Billy, and Fiona ☺️

"A truly humane service, kind-hearted people, and exceptional service! You can tell your pet is in good hands. And what can I say about the team... wow! Marie-Ève ​​is a gem! Let's just say Zen and I highly recommend your clinic! It's like one big family. 🐻‍❄️❤️" …
I sincerely want to thank the wonderful, professional, and caring team from this morning! Someone will bring the missing medications to my home, as I'm not there. Truly excellent work! 🥰 …
Amazing lady at the front desk, go to place if you really need help.
Qualified, caring and empathetic staff. I received excellent service.

This is the best vet clinic i have ever been to. They are compassionate, caring and very professional. The prices are reasonable, the clinic is spotless and the staff is beyond expectations. I would recommend ❤️
